styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Mercedes, Porsche and the Staatsgalerie in one compact centre.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Vineyards, parks and riverbank walks right in the city.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Swabian plates, market halls and wine taverns.

stays.why: Walk to the Schlossplatz, Staatsgalerie and main station. Best base for a first visit and for transit links.
Quiet, leafy streets with cafés and wine taverns. A short Stadtbahn ride or a walk downhill to the centre.
Near the Mercedes-Benz Museum, the Wasen festival ground and the mineral spas. Good S-Bahn links to the centre.
Hilltop area with views over the valley. Handy for the airport and the trade fair; quieter at night.

food: Try Swabian classics: Maultaschen (stuffed pasta), Spätzle with cheese, and Zwiebelrostbraten.
The Markthalle in the centre is good for a cheap lunch, local cheese and coffee; check opening days.
Look for a Besenwirtschaft (seasonal wine tavern) in the vineyards around Stuttgart for local wine and simple plates.
Beer gardens and brewery restaurants serve hearty plates; expect roughly EUR 12–20 for a main dish.
Book dinner on weekends. Many kitchens close early on Sundays; check on the day.
more_time: Add the Porsche Museum in Zuffenhausen if cars interest you; it is a separate trip from the Mercedes-Benz Museum.
Take the rack railway or cable car up to a viewpoint, then walk down through the vineyards.
In summer, swap a city afternoon for a half-day trip to Ludwigsburg Palace or Esslingen's old town.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the car museums, the art museums and a vineyard walk without rushing.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 5°C, and rain on many days. Pack a warm coat and plan indoor sights.
February: still cold, highs around 8°C. A good quiet month for museums.
March: cool and changeable, highs near 11°C. Bring layers and an umbrella.
April: milder at around 15°C, but showers are common. Good for walking between sights.
May: pleasant at around 18°C, though rain days peak. Keep a rain jacket handy.
June: warm at around 23°C with frequent showers. Long evenings are good for beer gardens.
July: the warmest month, highs near 25°C. Book hotels early and expect some rain.
August: warm like July, around 25°C. Popular holiday month, so book ahead.
September: mild and drier, around 21°C. One of the best months to visit.
October: cooler at around 16°C with more rain. Good for museums and the wine season.
November: chilly at around 10°C and often grey. Christmas markets usually start late in the month; check dates.
December: cold, highs near 7°C, with rain on many days. Dress warm for the Christmas markets.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate continental climate: cold winters, warm summers, and rain in every month. No month is reliably dry.

items.title: Best months: May to September
items.text: Highs of 18–25°C make walking and vineyard trips comfortable. July and August are warmest.

items.title: Cold winters
items.text: December to February highs of 5–8°C and lows near or below freezing. Bring a warm coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect 10–14 rain days every month. January and December are wettest; September is driest.

items.title: Pack layers
items.text: Days can warm up and cool down fast, especially in spring and autumn. A light waterproof layer helps.

items.title: Mild shoulder seasons
items.text: April, May and September are pleasant but changeable. Check the forecast each morning.

items.title: Long summer evenings
items.text: June to August stay light late, good for beer gardens and outdoor walks after dinner.

transit.best: Stadtbahn and S-Bahn for most trips; the centre is compact and walkable.

modes.text: Stadtbahn lines U1–U16 run underground in the centre and are fast and frequent. The S-Bahn (S1–S6) links the centre with suburbs and the airport.
Buses fill gaps in the network. Night buses run from Schlossplatz on weekends.
Taxis wait at Hauptbahnhof and the airport. Uber and Bolt work but are limited.
Driving is slow at rush hour. The centre is a low-emission zone, so a green sticker is needed.
The centre is compact and walkable. Bikes and e-scooters are common.
